_comment: Layout patches for the secondary-language slot (lang==1) and the top menu. (1) CN-mode layout constants set to the EN values (menu padding/gap/width addend in the draw routine 0x1AEB0 and all 13 touch maps, status-bar trigger font 14->12 px, DDS list x-offset); (2) English as factory-reset and blank-config default language; (3) 3-row top menu (row height 0x1A->0x12, row stride 0x20->0x14 in the draw routine; stride 0x20->0x14 and hit-box height 0x19->0x13 in the 13 touch maps), the same constants as the UA mod 1.2, so longer labels fit above the divider at y=0x68. One entry per changed instruction, disassembly in each note. Regenerate rather than hand-edit.
